name: ARLAW AI Global
release: Provision-aware legal retrieval precision and diagnostic script repair
release_scope: Adds explicit article/section anchor matching, improves passage ranking for numbered provisions, widens candidate retrieval for anchored legal questions, and adds regressions that check actual provision text rather than source titles alone. Repairs the optional Groq connectivity diagnostic. Does not add legal authorities, expand country coverage, certify legal accuracy, or complete production hardening.
